snippet.title: WEGO World War II: Overlord | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
WEGO World War II: Overlord is an operational-level, ground-centric WEGOWW2 game system.
Built on the engine of Desert War/Stalingrad, this hex-based wargame recreates the Allied invasion of Western Europe.
The game includes 14 historical scenarios, ranging from the landing at Omaha beach to a huge 135-turn campaign that covers the entire Normandy campaign.

Ⓜ️ More info on Matrix ➡️ https://www.matrixgames.com/game/wego-world-war-ii-overlord
